409.description:
Conflict; `code` is one of:

- `already_refunded` — the money is already on the balance.
- `order_in_flight` — the skin may still reach the buyer (or the attention is unresolved, or not a «nothing was bought» case).
- `order_not_refundable` — settled with nothing to give back (unpaid, cancelled, delivered).
- `order_busy` — a buy attempt is running; try again in a few minutes.
- `waxpeer_unavailable` — Waxpeer could not be asked whether a purchase exists; nothing was refunded, try again later.
- `idempotency_mismatch` — the key answered another request.

post.summary: Refund the order to the buyer's balance

post.description: «Разобрано»: stamps ``resolved_at/by/note`` once; already resolved → unchanged.

409.description:
Conflict; `code` is one of:

- `nothing_to_resolve` — the order has no trade, or its trade no attention.
- `idempotency_mismatch` — the key answered another request.

post.description:
Clears the resolved attention and makes the buy due now (``can_retry``); the next

409.description:
Conflict; `code` is one of:

- `not_retryable` — not a `buying`, unrefunded order with a resolved `buy_unconfirmed`, `ambiguous_trade` or `source_forbidden` attention and no purchase on record.
- `order_busy` — a buy attempt is running; try again in a few minutes.
- `idempotency_mismatch` — the key answered another request.

Keyless: rotation is inherently single-use, a replay is the attack it detects. Must
write nothing before :func:`refresh_session` — on reuse the service commits its

Verify the callback with Steam and open a session.

The signed ``return_to`` must carry the nonce of this browser's ``csmarket_oid``
cookie (login-CSRF defence). The nonce is single-use: the cookie is cleared on every
outcome, so a failure is retried from ``/auth/steam/start``.

Keyless by design: replaying an OpenID assertion is refused by Steam itself
(``check_authentication`` succeeds once), so an ``Idempotency-Key`` adds nothing.

anywhere else. The nonce goes into ``return_to`` (which Steam signs) and into the
``csmarket_oid`` cookie; :func:`steam_complete` requires the two to match.

Newest first; pass ``next_cursor`` back as ``cursor`` for the next page.

``type=topup`` keeps top-ups and their reversals; ``type=withdrawal`` is empty until

post.description:
Open a top-up in the chosen kassa; the response says where to pay.

``Idempotency-Key`` is required. The same key with the same amount and kassa returns
the same top-up (201 again); with another amount or kassa it is a 409
``idempotency_mismatch``.
